about: The player's numbers. hp and energy grow by perLevel each level. Energy refills by regen per second; hp starts refilling after hpRegen.delay seconds without being hit. expToNext(level) = round(exp.base * level ^ exp.growth). Skill damage grows by damagePerLevel for each level above 1. After a hit the player cannot be hurt for `invulnerable` seconds; when hp runs out they stay down for downTime seconds, then get up at the rest point with everything full and nothing lost. slots: the skills on the buttons, in order.
